title: Before You Play - Your First Plucks

lesson.instructions: Rest your right forearm lightly on the guitar and let your hand sit naturally near the sound hole. Keep your wrist relaxed. Gently pluck the thin high E string with your index finger, moving towards your palm. Let it ring, relax and try again three times. Your left hand can rest. Choose the open E target and listen for feedback; there is no timer.
